finalText:
Builds clean now (exit 0). The bundler bump changed two contracts that two call sites hadn't caught up with:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the new bundler passes options as `{ retryCount }`, but this still read `options.retries` (undefined), crashing on `.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the strict check only handled `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. Fixed to treat `undefined` as disabled (`false`), matching the old loader's behavior.

The remaining ~950 lines of output are just deprecation/dedupe/progress noise from the bump (DEP0142, DEP0198, etc.) — not errors, and unrelated to the crash, so I left those alone.
